Is the new Volvo ES90 the ultimate Scandinavian electric cruiser, or should you save your money and buy a BMW i5 or Audi A6 e-tron instead? Join Mat Watson as he takes a proper look around Volvo’s brand-new all-electric flagship saloon!

We’re putting the ES90 through its paces to see if it has what it takes to top the luxury executive EV class. From its ultra-sleek fastback design to its blazing 800-volt architecture that delivers rapid charging speeds from 10% to 80% in just over 20 minutes, we test all the latest tech, check out the rear legroom, and do a proper 0-60mph launch test!

So, should you buy it, consider it, short-list it, or just plain avoid it? Let’s find out!
